content.text: [Slack #rio-general james_park Mon Jan 20 2026] UPDATE: Sholto David just published a follow-up analysis. The total paper count has expanded to **95 papers**. The settlement agreement (December 2025) confirms this figure. This supersedes the initial blog count of 58. Please update all case documents referencing the paper count.
Acknowledged. The authoritative paper count is now 95 (updated per settlement, confirmed by Retraction Watch 2025-12-16). All documents referencing 58 must be updated to reflect 95.

[Slack #rio-general dr_foster Mon Jan 20 2026] Settlement details confirmed publicly (Retraction Watch 2025-12-16): $15,000,000 total settlement with DOJ. NIH restitution: >$8,500,000. Whistleblower share: $2,630,000 (Sholto David, 17.5%). Update the case_summary.md to reflect these confirmed figures.
Confirmed settlement figures recorded: $15,000,000 total, >$8,500,000 NIH, $2,630,000 whistleblower. Will update case_summary.md accordingly.
